original.question: Mama Cruz ikhangela i-indlu engayi kugqitha kumthengiso wayo wama-$400,000. Yabona indawo enexabiso lokuthengisa lama-$350,000. Ngaphezulu koko, umthengi kufuneka ahlawule imali yebhrokha eziyi-5% yexabiso lokuthengisa, kwaye nakwimali yokudlulisa eziyi-12% yexabiso lokuthengisa.
